set.body: Scope: PRD Phases 8-10. Extract interop and enforce executable source-import and build-edge guards; remove archive/latent types from dataset core under explicit compatibility policy; normalize the manifest and canonical writer with legacy translation and interrupted-publication evidence; then lock representation, persistence, dataset, locality, provenance, publication, registry, and migration-baseline laws. Close only when the dependency DAG is acyclic and mechanically enforced, old/new/unknown fixtures behave correctly, partial canonical writes never publish, every phase preserves the frozen numerical corpus, downstream scenarios remain green, and compileAll/testAll pass warning-clean on the exact committed tip.
